formal_statement: ¬ (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size ≤ 63 ∧ (∀ p w : Fin 13, (∃ dd ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13)), p = w + dd) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (13 + 13) C (fun k => decide (k = Fin.castAdd 13 p ∨ k = Fin.natAdd 13 w)) = true) ∧ (∀ P : Finset (Fin 13), (∀ v : Fin 13, v ∉ P → ∃ w2 : Fin 13, (∀ pp ∈ P, ¬ (∃ dd ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13)), pp = w2 + dd)) ∧ (∃ dd ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13)), v = w2 + dd)) → ((∃ w3 : Fin 13, ∀ p3 ∈ P, (∃ dd ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13)), p3 = w3 + dd)) ∨ (∃ v4 : Fin 13, ∀ w4 : Fin 13, (∀ pp ∈ P, ¬ (∃ dd ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13)), pp = w4 + dd)) → (∃ dd ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13)), v4 = w4 + dd))) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (13 + 13) C (fun kk : Fin (13 + 13) => decide ((∃ pp ∈ P, kk = Fin.castAdd 13 pp) ∨ (∃ ww : Fin 13, kk = Fin.natAdd 13 ww ∧ (∀ pp ∈ P, ¬ (∃ dd ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13)), pp = ww + dd))))) = false))
plain_statement: The negation, wrapped whole, of the search for at most 63 AND/OR gates (fan-in two) true at every incident one-point-one-line input and false at every degenerate maximal false input. Plane of order 3: points 0..12, lines 0..12 (inputs 13..25), point p on line w when p - w mod 13 is 0, 1, 3 or 9. A maximal false input: a point set P on, with every line missing P on, such that every point outside P lies on a line missing P. It is generic when P lies inside no line and the lines missing P do not all pass through one point; degenerate otherwise. Expected false. Conjecture.
title: Order-3 plane: every fan-in-two AND/OR circuit true at incident pairs and false at all degenerate maximal false inputs has at least 64 gates
